mara: Quick follow-up from the fused-attn RFC — thinking about a runtime gateway between fused-QKV and fused-bias/rope variants. Outline: prefer fused-QKV+bias when model manifest advertises capability, otherwise fallback to dropoutless generic kernel. Questions: how do we represent the capability matrix in the manifest, and do we allow per-request overrides?

sanford: I like a manifest flag. simplest: model.manifest.features = ["fused_qkv", "fused_bias_rope", "dropoutless"] so kernel_selector matches by subset. per-request overrides are useful for canaries but should be limited.

lee: per-request overrides are risky — some kernels change the KV cache layout which breaks caching across requests. Gate per-request overrides to only switches that preserve KV layout, otherwise require kv flush/rehandoff.

toni: +1. Also: telemetry. We need counts for requests routed to each variant and latency/token deltas so we can measure perf/regressions quickly.

mara: Agreed. Propose rollout config: percent traffic to variant, shard-level sampling, auto-rollback on output divergence > threshold.

devops-bot: deploy note: canary kernel build deployed to runtime pool r-priv-2 at 2026-03-19 14:30 UTC.

sanford: On determinism: fused-bias may change FP rounding behavior. Eval must include token-level diffs and semantic similarity (BERTScore / BLEURT) thresholds. We'll add an eval harness.

lee: If fused kernel changes softmax/scale ordering, quantization (int8) must align pre-scaling. Suggest we define a small kernel contract doc: `pre_norm_scale`, `post_softmax_scale`, `kv_layout`.

toni: Proposed handshake API snippet:
```
capability = runtime.query_model_capabilities(model_id)
if "fused_bias_rope" in capability:
  route = "fused_bias_path"
elif "dropoutless" in capability:
  route = "dropoutless_path"
else:
  route = "baseline"
```

mara: That works. Add a `kv_abi_hash` to manifest — a short hash of kernel ABI so runtime can refuse to use cached KV if ABI changes.

sanford: Good call. Also expose ops toggle to disable fused paths per-customer for support triage.

lee: Ops toggle should be a routing policy flag scoped to tenant; do not expose as public API.

toni: To avoid manifest churn, register capability sets in the model_catalog store keyed by (model_id, version) and have runtime subscribe to catalog updates. Runtime treats unknown capability as opt-out.

mara: Catalog approach is better. Migration plan: when a new model version flips fused flag, old runtimes should treat unknown as absent to avoid accidental routing.

devx: SDK change: new optional header `X-Desired-Kernel: fused_bias` for opt-in testing. Default: none. Document in SDK changelog.

mara: Action items: 1) sanford write kernel ABI spec PR; 2) lee add `kv_abi_hash` check + routing prototype; 3) toni add telemetry metrics + rollout proto; 4) devx document SDK header and examples. Schedule canary next week.

sanford: I'll start the ABI doc and ping for review.

lee: I'll prototype runtime gating in branch `runtime/gate-fused-abi`.

toni: Drafting telemetry proto in infra/telemetry repo this afternoon.

mara: Thanks all — unless objections I'll post RFC follow-up summary in eng-runtime channel later today. :thumbsup:
